Hi Samantha —

Looping in the contract and procurement lane. A couple of quick notes from legal/procurement perspective: 

- Thanks for naming Michael and Gabe — that helps. From our experience with health systems, procurement will typically own the PO process and sometimes require a finance approver signature. If Michael is the VP Finance, he will almost always be the authorizer; procurement will handle the contract language and PO issuance.
- Typical procurement cadence we see for pilots is 7–12 business days once procurement has a full packet (SOW, SOC2 scope, DPA). If you have an internal timeline next week, flag any hard cutoff dates so we can prioritize.
- Attaching a 1-page SOC2 scope we usually share and a sample vendor packet outline; Gabe can point to any additional artifacts he needs.

Next steps from our side:
1) We will send the SOC2 scope one-pager (rwd-soc2-scope-onepager.pdf) and an updated MAP by EOD today.
2) Karthik will include ballpark pricing in the spreadsheet; once Michael and Priya confirm the approver flow we’ll move the SOW to procurement for redlines.

If Michael or Priya prefer, we can do a 15-min intro call Thurs to walk the packet.
